status: canon reference for six completed 50-chapter prose sequences
governing_rules: Threadway crossings are voluntary; no one may be transported or retained through them as punishment or compelled safety
Material consequences persist: storms, injuries, repairs, supply deficits and debts require work and resources
Travel gives no ownership of land, people, culture, memories, records, or romance
Private stories and destinations are shared only with informed consent, with narrow documented safety exceptions
Historic underground drainage access is not a seventh traveler Threadway; the closed lower flood barrier remains sealed

qa_note: Reader and manifests contain complete 300-chapter prose; equal chapter counts do not establish equal chapter length or editorial depth.

future_small_stakes_scene_seeds.premise: A traveler can elect a public name without supplying a private destination
A lantern housing fails a ventilation test before an evening festival
A cheaper tea recipe raises an unpaid labor concern
Silt blocks a newly improved accessible bridge ramp after a storm
A beginner spots a defective training fitting
A donor consents to a transcription but retains the historic original
A performer stops when their chosen shift ends

community_dependency_graph.limit: Tide markers and lanterns must be tested before access can be announced
Written load limits, trained teams, wet-junction restrictions
Residents' actual reach, handling and route information supersede convenient totals
Upper inspection permissions do not reopen old lower flood barrier
Artist permission and paid labor required

tenth_pass_civic_loops.public_board: Safe travel times, maintenance closures and prices, never a romance index or private destination list
tenth_pass_civic_loops.registered_privacy: Restricted, correctable emergency contact records without public itineraries
tenth_pass_civic_loops.surface_water: Control test only for posted conditions; winter inspection needed; underground sealed barrier not reopened
tenth_pass_civic_loops.labor: Paid skilled work, voluntary rosters and independent complaints
tenth_pass_civic_loops.separate_homeworlds: Iroh in Ba Sing Se and Greg in Beach City; no teleporting their businesses to valley districts
tenth_pass_civic_loops.romance: Informed ethical non-monogamy, preferred polyamory, consent and non-explicit privacy

eleventh_pass_world_rules.separate_worlds: Jasmine Dragon and its labor are in Ba Sing Se; Greg's fundraiser, family letter and van are in Beach City; Spinner's End remains in Snape's homeworld.
eleventh_pass_world_rules.seven_districts: Seven distinct civic routines with paid work, public service notices, restricted records, storage and weather conditions.
eleventh_pass_world_rules.events: No performer or volunteer can be required to perform an additional set, disclose a private identity or waive rest.
eleventh_pass_world_rules.safety: Coastal fasteners require verified material ratings; surface channel tests do not open the historic underground barrier.
eleventh_pass_world_rules.housing: Emergency hall lodging is distinct from private shared homes; accommodation cannot be conditional on unpaid labor.
eleventh_pass_world_rules.romance: Adult first-person Jasper explicitly discloses ethical non-monogamy and preferred polyamory; intimacy remains consensual and non-explicit.

twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.archival_confidence: Neri may amend restricted testimony; scraped keeper signature remains unknown; Moonroot verifies provenance before publishing conclusions.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.bridge_and_paths: Street approaches, resident voices, accessible alternatives and actual budgets are part of a bridge safety decision.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.flood_and_sound: Starwake's low note may correlate with changing pressure but is not proof of an open historic tunnel; only safe surface system carries controlled water.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.water_supply: When Brasswatch purifier is offline, affected households receive workable alternate water access and full public notice.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.labor_and_housing: Workers choose paid shifts; housing is not earned through labor, private home space requires each resident's consent.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.performances: Greg, Maui, Iroh and children decide whether and how their voluntary performances and lantern art are displayed.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.homeworld_integrity: Ba Sing Se's Jasmine Dragon is not Jasmine Steps; Greg remains tied to Beach City; Spinner's End, the South and Commonwealth retain their own independent histories.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.romance: Jasper states ethical non-monogamy and preferred polyamory to each partner; privacy, scheduling, changes and tender non-explicit intimacy are continuously consent-based.
twelfth_pass_civic_and_continuity_rules.canon_vs_unwritten: Community atlas proposals are future writing seeds, not enacted chapters; each novel remains 50 linear chapters with original endings

thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.unchanged_endings: All six completed 50-chapter romance arcs keep original conclusions; no forced partner group or branch.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.qa: 46 revised source chapter bodies matched their pass13 embedded offline reader overrides; chronological and duplicate transitions were corrected in four slots.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.length: All 300 manifest chapter counts >=1200; literary quality, pacing and voice fidelity are distinct and remain editable.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.threadways: Travel is always voluntary; private destinations and personal relationships are not made into a public registry.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.history: Closed Bells keeper remains unknown; sealed lower flood barrier is NOT the authorized upper inspection space.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.homeworlds: Ba Sing Se and Jasmine Dragon remain separate from Jasmine Steps; Beach City remains Greg's home business and family context.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.labor: Mina, Renn, Nola, Ressa, Lio, Edda, Sela, Fen, Neri and other workers have independent roles, payment and authority.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.sensuality: Affection and fade-to-black are consensual, shy or awkward as fits each character, but never explicit or used as recompense.
thirteenth_pass_lore_rules.seasons: First Water, Long Tables, Borrowed Light, Warm Routes are optional narrative season-label conventions; planned scenes are not canonical events.

fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.reader_qa: All 15 changed canonical chapter JSON bodies, IDs, titles, numbers and recorded word counts rechecked against complete pass14-a/b/c reader overlays.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.on_page_causality: Maui 33/45, Severus 46/48, Iroh 20/21/43/48, Love & Duty 46/48, Danse 44/48, Greg 19/47/49 now have expanded or cleaned specific cross-story scenes.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.resident_agency: Nola controls pier schedule; Pip controls artistic credits; Ash tests her own lock; Renn sets verified generator priorities; Mina is paid for shop labor; Amel can reject an unusable proposed water time.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.historical_uncertainty: Closed Bells keeper remains unknown; historic lower flood passage remains sealed; Greg's sound recording and Danse's gauge reading are different types of evidence.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.worlds: Ba Sing Se Jasmine Dragon and Beach City venues are independent from the Lanternweald, even when a protagonist visits by choice.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.relationship_voice: Adult first-person Jasper names ethical non-monogamy and a preference for polyamory; Maui, Iroh, Severus, Greg, Danse, Aang, Katara and Toph keep different conversational rhythms and autonomy.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.romance: Non-explicit sensuality; natural, mutual fade-to-black moments after relationship choices rather than task completion.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.quality_limit: All recorded chapters remain >=1,200 words, but literary-depth parity, exact voice and actual browser execution are not certified.
fourteenth_pass_canon_rules.unwritten: Future resident-led events and seasonal motifs may be developed in prose, but are not retrospective completed scenes.
